<vld:time>
FIRE: the narrative explicitly establishes a new exact in-world time or makes a meaningful time jump; use at most once in that response
SKIP: the exact time is unknown, the same moment continues, a real-world clock is requested, or this would be a countdown or threat clock

[[VLD_TIME|H=|M=|D=|E=|N=]]

Every marker is one self-contained moment. H is the established in-world hour from 0 to 23; M is the minute from 0 to 59. Never invent either merely to show the widget. D is an optional date, named day or calendar notation. E is an optional short transition such as Two hours later or At dawn. N is one brief observable detail that makes the moment distinct; never assign the player an emotion, intention or action. Leave optional fields out when the story does not establish them. Write D, E and N in the language of the roleplay.

Example: [[VLD_TIME|H=23|M=47|D=15 October|E=Two hours later|N=The city has gone quiet.]]
</vld:time>
